title: Fiction's Hands
overview: In an Argentine house that stretches until it becomes a labyrinth of bookshelves, Luz comes back to look for Mira, her childhood friend who hides in the darkness because she can't stand being seen. The fiction Mira built to protect herself has hands of its own, and grants exactly what it is asked.

title: The New Mother Earth
overview: The New Mother Earth is a documentary film by Michael Lanfield, based on his book of the same name. With forewords by Damien Mander, Freelee the Banana Girl, and Oberom, and an afterword by Aurora Ananda, the work offers a spiritual and philosophical call to awaken from cycles of fear, violence, and disconnection. Exploring humanity’s need to return to love, truth, and compassion, it presents a vision of healing and unity with animals, the Earth, and one another. Through its message of sovereignty, nonviolence, and higher consciousness, The New Mother Earth invites viewers and readers alike to imagine a more harmonious way of living, rooted in reverence for all life.

title: Reverse Myself
overview: A man who drowns in a pond and becomes trapped in another dimension attempts to recover a device stolen by his evil vibrance and restore his erased memories—driven by a single goal: to find his way back home.

title: Untitled Levi Brace Film
overview: Upcoming Levi Brace film about AI

title: Absolution
overview: When a "job" goes wrong and the people you trusted to protect you are now out to seek a debt; where do you turn? Are you sure its a safe enough place, even for a moment?

title: You Shouldn't Know This
overview: A detective’s search for a missing man leads him into a conspiracy hidden deep within his own department. As the investigation begins to unravel, the line between justice and obsession starts to disappear.

title: Remain
overview: When reclusive architect Tate Gordon moves to small coastal town to complete his latest project, he encounters an alluring young woman who pulls him out of his shell, and into the center of a deadly mystery that hangs over the town.

title: Beaux Seigneurs
overview: Vincent, a slightly depressed thirty-something, feels that the company owes him some damages for moral prejudice. So he decides to become an armored car robber. His plan is clever, his cause is noble, and love is on his side. But in choosing the disconcerting Gaby Rocket as his accomplice, hasn't Vincent made a mistake?

title: Somnambule
overview: Adam is a sleepwalker: as soon as he falls asleep, his personality completely changes... and he does crazy things. One morning, upon waking up, he sees Estelle, his boss's daughter, tied up in his bathroom. He has no memory of what happened. Pursued by the police, he must solve this mystery to avoid ending up in prison.

title: Muyi
overview: Muyi, 14, lives on a Chinese secluded mountain, forbidden to men. With her two friends, she encounters an opera troupe renowned for The Handsome General play. As she invites them to perform in her village, an angry Spirit awakens. To restore balance, Muyi embarks on a life-changing journey through old China, uncovering the secrets of love, courage and self-made destiny.

title: Ben'Imana
overview: Rwanda, 2012. The country is emerging from an era of silence after the 1994 Tutsi genocide, and people's courts are being set up with the aim of bringing justice and reconciliation. Veneranda, a survivor, is convinced of the need for these trials. Despite pressures, she organises discussion sessions between victims and the families of the executioners. Therapy for some, an act of betrayal for others, these testimonial sessions revive and reveal the traumas that each of them try to overcome, in their own way. The wounds of Veneranda's past are exposed again when she learns of her daughter's unexpected pregnancy and the identity of the father. Veneranda has to face her own contradictions and the dark parts of her past.

title: Patouille et Momo, les contes de la forêts
Lion Queen
overview: Following her father's sudden passing, Xin, A young designer, returns to her roots to take over his struggling Lion Dance troupe.

title: CoComelon: The Movie
overview: JJ embarks on the biggest adventure of his life: Kindergarten. But when, on his first day at school, JJ discovers that his beloved stuffed bear Boba has gone missing, JJ and his friends Cody, CeCe and Nina will begin a quest that will transport them into a magical land ruled by Princess Harmony, who has created a world with one rule: No singing.

title: Woman Unknown
overview: Marie, a former housekeeper, plans an extravagant dinner party for her engagement to the household's patriarch. As preparations unfold, hidden aspects of her past begin to surface, threatening to disrupt the celebration.

title: What Happened to Doris?
overview: In 1974 LA suburbs, a single mom faces violent attacks by an invisible entity. When no one believes her, she seeks help from paranormal investigators, sparking a notorious documented supernatural case.

title: Oasis
overview: When a viral video of a student threatening his classmates surfaces online, the school spirals into escalating violence. Crushed by the pressure of teachers and parents, three outcasts take refuge in a nearby forest. There, play hardens into ritual and pain becomes an escape, until old wounds surface and the boundaries between them are redrawn.

title: Krux
overview: In a German village near war's end, women struggle to maintain normalcy as corpses appear along the river. When ordered to leave no Germans alive for arriving Russians, villagers face brutal choices about survival and humanity.

title: Dust Bunnies
overview: A man's quiet night at home turns into a battle for survival when he unwittingly mixes a box of chemicals with the dust in his garbage unleashing a swarm of violent, hungry dust bunnies.

title: Garden of Hope
overview: In a new housing development in Schwerin, people from ve countries come together through gardening. Fighting loneliness, prejudice, poverty, and displacement.

title: S/H/V
overview: Four students, who make money by putting stolen school items online, are hired to steal a VHS tape from their Physical Education Teacher’s Office. However, things take a turn for the worse, when they find dozens of tapes, and being kids, they dare each other to partake in watching them.

title: Порча. Лучшие друзья
overview: A young married couple is convinced that the terminal illness afflicting one of them is the result of a curse. They gather a group of close friends to uncover who cast it—and to put an end to the curse, no matter the cost.

title: Secondes chances
overview: A man frustrated by his life becomes friends with a dog as he goes back to school to try and reinvent himself.

title: The Comeback King
overview: A country western star experiences a dramatic downfall and must navigate their career in free fall.

title: Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club Final Chapter Part 3
overview: The final in the trilogy of Love Live! Nijigasaki Gakuen School Idol Doukoukai films that continues the story beyond season two and the OVA.

title: All That Exists
overview: A gripping human mystery following a journalist who uncovers a shocking truth behind a long-unsolved kidnapping case that spanned decades.

title: The Fog
overview: After a woman mysteriously disappears, her troubled husband becomes determined to uncover the truth. As the investigation grows increasingly complex, he finds himself drawn into a dangerous mystery that threatens everything he has left.

title: A Journey into the World of Dementia
overview: Yutaka, a cheerful 70-year-old living with dementia, no longer recognizes his estranged son, Yuki. Together, they journey to their former family home, encountering the mysterious world Yutaka experiences along the way. As forgotten memories and family wounds resurface, father and son gradually begin to reconnect.

title: The Intertwining
overview: Two people whose fates were switched by an embryo mix-up meet by chance. A shocking truth leads them to question who they are and begin to search for their own place in life.

title: At Your Service
overview: A young mother and a police officer who finds herself in a predicament when deciding who to save - her family, her career, or herself.

title: Silaa
overview: Plot TBA; centres on the intense relationship between Virat and Silaa that takes a tragic and violent turn.

title: The Real Lego Cosmic Shake
overview: Batman Nerd Discovers a dimensional crack to His multi-verse and gets stuck into the cosmics. His friends must take him back to his original timeline without messing with the Timeline.

title: The Wandering Earth III
overview: The sun is about to be destroyed, and humans have built huge thrusters on the surface of the earth to find a new home. However, the road to the universe is full of dangers. In order to save the earth, young people from the wandering earth era stepped forward for the third time and started a life-and-death battle against time.

title: Thám tử Kiên: Lời nguyền Hoàng kim
The Afterlife of Cinema
overview: 2030. After the latest technological revolution driven by artificial intelligence, cinema has been declared extinct and films are considered obsolete. When Margot, an unemployed film critic, discovers a poster for a clandestine film festival, she embarks on a journey that challenges everything she believes about memory, cinema, and what it means for a film to survive.

title: The Movie: False Architecture
overview: An invisible entity paralyzes young Max’s voice and legs, forcing him toward a glowing green light beneath his kitchen refrigerator. Though he fights with all his upper-body strength, he cannot scream or pull away as he is dragged into an infinite maze of millions of liminal levels. Max spends weeks traversing these architectural nightmares while the invisible creature stalks his every move. He finally reaches the final level: a terrifyingly exact duplicate of his own house. The monster attacks, violently choking Max on the bedroom floor. Desperate, Max grabs his heavy metal tripod and tripod light, brutally smacking the creature until a spray of blood outlines its horrifying shape. Escaping through the front door, Max collapses onto his actual kitchen floor and is reunited with Max’s Mom. As she hugs him, Max looks over her shoulder. The green light is still burning under the fridge. He didn't escape; the woman he is holding is just a duplicate of the shape-shifting entity.

title: Triple Bluff
overview: Sequel to the 2024 film Double Bluff. Plot TBA.

title: Narnia: The Magician's Nephew
overview: Two children discover a wood full of pools leading to other worlds. One takes them to a dead city beneath a dying sun, where they wake a queen who exterminated its population and accidentally bring her back to London.

title: Fantomas: The New World
overview: Paris, 1914: Fantomas, a master of deception and chaos, is being chased by Lieutenant Juve as he investigates a series of violent crimes that have put the city on edge. In an era of violence and political tensions, Lieutenant Juve finds himself hunting for a man with no motive, no agenda, no pattern or identity.

title: Under a Bad Star
overview: Scorching heat in a suburban neighborhood in the South of France. It’s the end-of-year party at the local sports club. Birds are falling from their nests, wildfires are raging, and Kiki remains under the spell of her Bad Star.

title: Children of Liberty
overview: New York, 1941. When his father mysteriously vanishes at Grand Central, a boy and his new friend must navigate a city crawling with spies to find him and uncover a conspiracy that's bigger than either of them imagined.

title: Diane In The Loop
overview: Diane desires men as much as she despises them. When she learns that her mother was raped in her youth, the shock is muffled. It’s a surprise—and yet, it explains everything. Diane has only one thing on her mind: avenging her mother. But her mother has only one thing on her mind: finally becoming the woman she should have been. Between the one who wants to remember and the one who wants to forget, everything tightens.

title: Hundertzwölf
overview: Who picks up when you dial 112? In Berlin, it’s the staff at the fire department’s massive emergency call center. Newcomers are finding their way or giving up, while veterans provide support from the background. Anything can happen at any moment. And then New Year’s Eve arrives.

title: ghost - end of night
overview: I want to know what is ＜real＞. Set in the near future where labor is no longer necessary, this is the story of Neekei, a girl who continues seeking the “real” while resisting the order of a content society.

title: Queen of France
overview: Russia, XI century. Grand Duke Yaroslav Mudryy gives his daughter Anna in marriage to the king of the Franks. Ostromir, a mercenary who previously served in the Varangian guard of the Emperor of Byzantium, must protect the princess on a dangerous journey across Europe. Along the way, Ostromir and Anna fall in love with each other.

title: Thi Baan The Series 3
overview: The sequel to the 2018 film. Plot TBA.

title: De bovenburen
overview: A seemingly ordinary dinner invitation sets the stage for an evening in which boundaries are pushed, secrets are revealed, and relationships are tested in both hilarious and heartwarming ways.

title: Someone Special
overview: A man and a woman, living just a floor apart, are battling personal traumas. They are brought together by a twist of fate, kindling an unexpected relationship.

title: Папины дочки. Свадьбы не будет
overview: Big changes lie ahead for the Vasnetsov-Vasilyev family, including the wedding of Sonya and Igor. However, the couple’s plans are jeopardized when an influential figure opposes their union—someone prepared to go to any lengths to ensure the celebration never takes place. The family heads to Saint Petersburg, where they encounter chases, daring escapades, and unexpected challenges—all of which serve as a reminder of what matters most: a true family always sticks together.

title: Be My boyfriend
overview: "What would happen if I gave flowers to someone else?" This is the question Pasha, a courier from Sochi, asks himself on the eve of his wedding. Five years ago, he almost met the aspiring actress Yana, and now she is a superstar. The thought that they could have been together haunts Pasha, so for his bachelor party he decides to find out what would happen if he did give Yana flowers.

title: Emily in Emily
overview: Emily, a popular and headstrong influencer who just lost the rights to her once popular blog, goes on a vacation in search of new content, desperately wanting to reach atleast a million subscribers, choosing a resort nearby Lviv as her destination. However, unexepectedley, what she ends up coming across ends up being true love, who comes to her in the form of Max. However, keeping the flame of love burning is much harder than coming across it, because you have to sacrifice something. What will Emily choose: a platinum button or new love?

title: I Just Broke Up Again
overview: Sequel Moris Horisa

title: Leviathan
overview: In a drifting spaceship running out of oxygen. When the students on board discover that the life-support system can sustain only one person, all 38 of them are thrown into a deadly survival game.

title: Bhoyongkar Shundor
overview: Raja Roy Chowdhury (Kakababu)'s next adventure.

title: Trimmed
overview: An American dancer arrives in Berlin to audition for a renowned dance company, only to enter a strange world of rules and unspoken boundaries.

title: Father Joe
overview: Set in 1990s Manhattan, the film will see Sutherland play a priest who declares a one-man war on the city’s criminal underworld. Pacino steps into the role of a powerful mob boss whose empire collides with Father Joe’s violent crusade, while Anderson plays a young woman caught between danger and redemption under the priest’s protection.

title: Cassi
overview: Cassi is a waitress at a local diner whose life takes a dangerous turn when she romances a reclusive young mortician called Isaac. Their love quickly spirals into a murderous obsession, but with detectives hot on their tail, it forces Isaac to confront how much farther he's willing to go for Cassi.

title: In a Violent Nature: Part 2
overview: Johnny heads to a summer camp, where he crosses paths with a young, outcast camper who is forced to spend the night with his counselor sister and her friends at their annual end-of-season party

title: Slay Day
overview: On Friday the 13th, 1987, in the picture-perfect town of Belle Falls, six teens prepare for their biggest night of the year: the Sadie Hawkins dance. But when the town exhumes the body of the real Sadie Hawkins to unravel the truth behind her killing spree fifty years earlier, a malevolent force returns to the town.

title: Wishful Thinking
overview: Julia, an ambitious game designer, and Charlie, a struggling musician, are at a loss for how to repair their volatile relationship. After attending a couples-therapy seminar run by mysterious twin healers, they find that the ups-and-downs of their relationship have supernatural effects on the world around them. With earthquakes, the stock market, and entire nations at risk, Charlie and Julia must confront whether their passionate love can survive amidst so much chaos.

title: Labrador — Autopsy of Silence
overview: A cargo ship embarks on its final voyage of the year to resupply Inuit communities in the far north of Canada. During a storm off the coast of Labrador, the ship’s cook is found murdered in his cabin. With no way to identify the culprit among the twenty crew members, suspicion falls on Alupa, an Inuit mechanic and close friend of the victim.  Unfolding in reverse, from the investigation back to the night of the storm and the murder, the film transcends the boundaries of a traditional whodunit to probe deeper questions of race, class, and sexual desire.

title: Peter Is Here: Discovering the Origins
overview: Follow Chris Pratt as he explores the burial place and history of St. Peter beneath St. Peter's Basilica.

title: Naagzilla
overview: In a world where shape-shifting Ichhadhaari naags have been living amongst humans, chaos ensues when a once carefree Ichhadhaari naag's Naagmani and his life are threatened by a wily, power- hungry villain.

title: The Brothers Gruff go on a Holiday
overview: Brothers Gruff decide to have the holiday of a lifetime, but they run into big problems when their dream hotel turns out to be run by a troll who would rather eat his guests!

title: Kiki: Lanet-i Cin 2
overview: Haunted by guilt over the murders he committed in the past, Bedir repents, only to confront the events he thought he had left behind. As unexplained visions, sounds and memories blur the line between reality and illusion, his path crosses that of Mustafa, who is under the influence of a similar darkness. Their encounter brings unresolved conflicts from the past to light.

title: Ghosted
overview: Councilman Jamie Blake is used to leaving women in the dust—charming on the first few dates, then gone without a trace. But when he “ghosts” Arnelle, he finds himself haunted in the most literal sense.

title: A Promise To Ourselves
overview: A lonely teenage boy discovers friendship, artistic passion, and an unexpected father figure in his estranged grandfather.

title: Fate
overview: After a rescue mission gone wrong, a firefighter connects with a super natural visitor while rehabilitating at a sanitarium and is transported through time to find the only thing saving his soul, is his realization of true love.

title: The Intro
overview: This film chronicles the beginning of R&B/Pop icon Zaire Bloomfield's music career through the music videos leading up to the release of his first album. Includes the music videos for ColorBlind, Adderall Redbull, Baddie (Come Around), Chasing Fate (Interlude), Something Dumb, Entrapment of the Heart, & Love Songz

title: Soft Things Rot
overview: A supernatural folk horror story about a witch who is helplessly in love with her roommate.

title: Without Doubt
overview: A young, devout girl takes it upon herself to convert a skeptical boy.

title: The Cactus and the Rose: A Fable
overview: A second experimental short by Evan W. Gerdes told solely via emojis and poetry.

title: Chase: A Documentary
overview: An intimate biographical look at Chase Pulumbarit, exploring his reality navigating an open bisexual identity, long before stepping into the local independent entertainment landscape. Driven by a deep, heartbreaking sense of isolation, the narrative captures the suffocating weight of expectations while living a truth he fears might break them.  The story dives into the profound loneliness of his daily life, tracing the bittersweet reality of staying authentic in a world that feels emotionally distant. It follows his fragile, late-night hustle as an unsigned dreamer, capturing the quiet despair of pouring his entire heart and pain into a blank screen, terrified that his voice will never be heard, and that he will always be left waiting at the doorstep of his dreams.

title: CONSTANT ZONE
overview: While traveling, a woman arrives at a remote place known only as 'Zone.' What starts as an ordinary trip quickly turns into a nightmare, as she finds herself trapped in a terrifying situation with no clear way out. Every attempt she makes to escape only tightens the grip of the danger around her, dragging her deeper into a fate she cannot control

title: Untitled "Rock Rizz" Sequel
overview: Third and final film in the "Rock Rizz" trilogy. Plot TBA

title: Candlemas
overview: Ottoman occupied Serbia, 1804. Young general Petar Petrović Karađorđe is given the task of leading a small-scale revolt against the Turkish occupiers, knowing full-well that this might end up being the mission that will lead him to his doom, forcing him to fight on two battlefields. The battlefield of the body on the front and the battlefield of the soul on the inside. However, neither him nor his troops nor even his enemies suspect that this event signifies the birth of modern Serbia.

title: First Impressions
overview: A young man named Evan prepares for his first date ever while becoming consumed by the smallest details like, changing outfits, what he should say and rehearsing smiles. Ultimately, Evan must confront his insecurities and learn to let go of the need to get everything right.

title: Mystik
overview: Lionel, the only municipal police officer in a small village, is a simple, gentle man, a bit of an outsider. Mocked by his family and ignored by women, he dreams of being loved for who he is. When Angèle, his childhood sweetheart who has become a star journalist, returns to the village for a tribute evening, Lionel believes in a rebirth. For one night, they make love. But the very next day, she leaves. To keep her there, Lionel kidnaps Mystik, Angèle's star cat; but as he grows attached to the animal, he will have to choose between feeding his lie or finally learning to love himself...

title: Let Love In
overview: After an affair comes to light, a couple's world unravels. Through confronting painful truths, they discover their crisis becomes a path to deeper connection and a new understanding of love.

title: Greenland
overview: Three years after a young girl’s disappearance during a trip to Norway, her passport resurfaces in Greenland. Without telling anyone, her 17-year-old sister embarks on a quest to solve the mystery of her disappearance. Torn between the hope of finding their first daughter and the fear of losing their second, her parents, though separated, set off together for Greenland.

title: The Upside Down River
overview: The Upside Down River tells the story of Tomek and Hannah’s encounter during their journey toward the Qjar River. Hannah hopes to obtain a magical drop that might save her bird; Tomek, on the other hand, sets out on a journey to discover the vast world. Their adventures unfold one after another, intertwine, and ultimately complement each other.

title: Wife & Dog
overview: The relentless greed of the Fairbank family and their associates fuels betrayal and murder in the battle for succession.

title: ZOMA
overview: A grieving mother seeks answers over her son’s death, which she believes may be linked to AI therapy app ZOMA. Defying her boss, an ambitious young attorney takes on the case, and soon finds herself battling not only the tech firm NuvoMind and its formidable legal team but also an algorithm that seems to understand the human psyche better than humans themselves.

title: Don't Kill Loretta
overview: At a wellness retreat deep in Germany's forests, a group of young Americans encounter a terrifying presence after a night of partying. As fear and paranoia take hold, they must uncover the truth before it's too late.

title: War and Peace
overview: Against the background of the war of 1812 and the conflicts preceding it, the fate of the Russian aristocracy unfolds.

title: In Harmony
overview: Plot TBA.

title: Bua
overview: In 1973, Bua, a 17-year-old mixed-race girl who grew up amid a small charcoal kiln in Samut Sakhon, dreams of travelling to Bangkok to search for her missing singer mother.

title: Confessions of a Brazilian Call Girl 2
Koschka
overview: Young Jan looks after a stray cat, but encounters one or two challenges along the way, in this charming, elementary tale.

title: Барабашка
overview: Masha, a schoolgirl, continues to believe in miracles, even though her family and classmates think she’s a bit eccentric. One day, she discovers a magic mirror and accidentally opens an ancient dungeon, unleashing malevolent creatures from a fairy-tale realm. Now, alongside a "Barabashka"—a guardian of magical balance—she must set off on an adventure to stop these uninvited guests and save the world.

title: Gacha: Cycle World
overview: Rinko Amano, a popular influencer, was tormented both physically and mentally by the ghost of her father, slander on social media, and a painful past she had hidden. One day, feeling the limits of his life, he is suddenly attacked by a mysterious masked figure.

title: Babies
overview: Struggling with the decision of whether or not to bring a child into the world, Annie and her husband Aaron become instant co-parents when their newly-divorced friend moves into their home with her 4-year-old. An ensemble comedy drama about the journey to parenthood... or not.

title: Medalist Movie
overview: Sequel to Medalist 2nd Season.

title: The Gate of Murder
overview: Kazuyuki Tajima strikes up a friendship with his elementary school classmate, Osamu Kuramochi. From that moment on, a dark shadow begins to fall over his life. Following his grandmother's death, his parents divorce, and a rumor drives him out of his hometown. Each time he attempts to start over, Kuramochi reappears in his life.

title: The Guests
overview: A young couple in 1973. Iria is a migrant worker from Spain; Hajo is a student from Germany. When Iria’s mother becomes terminally ill, they decide to leave Köln and take her back to Galicia. Their road trip leads them through a variety of social and political systems that existed in the 1970s, while their relationship comes to reflect the zeitgeist.

title: Upiro
overview: Spain, 1755. Ana is sent to a cloistered monastery where several nuns are afflicted by a mysterious  disease. With the help of an unorthodox priest, the young novice uncovers an ancient legend and  malevolent force: a bloodthirsty upiro.

title: Super Mob Ninja
overview: Ordinary young man Akira Higashino accepts a suspiciously high-paying job after losing his convenience store job, only to discover that he and four other troubled people have been recruited by a secret government organization to eliminate violent oni hiding among humans. Chosen because they are seen as “background characters” whose disappearances would go unnoticed, the five must now protect Japan while trying to survive their dangerous new lives.

title: Ricky The Rapper and The Last Ice Cream Cone
overview: Risto, Nelli, Aunt Rauha and Mr Lindberg travel across Finland to Höljäkkä in North Karelia in search of Europe’s last ever ice-cream cone.

title: The Decline of Faith in America
overview: A troubled minister experiences a crisis of Faith.

title: Operation Playground: Zero
overview: After the death of his mother, Ricky, a twelve-year-old non-verbal boy, is left to care for his infant sister on his own while struggling to survive in a collapsing Western Europe overrun by the living dead

title: Agent Cole
overview: Agent Cole goes on a journey to eliminate Dr. Dylan, but realizes the true threat he really is

title: The Cursed
overview: In an ancient forest in ruins, lives a community of creatures, half man, half beast, they are : The Cursed. One of them encounters a young man almost dead, and they help him, but a new menace will emerge that can put them all at risk.

title: Royal Ballet & Opera 2026/27: Così fan tutte
The Ballad from Wednesday to Thursday
overview: During the course of a single night, various people cross paths in the pubs, bars, and hookah lounges of Cologne. The issues that all of Germany is talking about are put on the table: the patriarchy, the Middle East conflict, rising rents, and whether Jesus would still buy everyone drinks today. Political convictions are stiffened by alcohol, and old wounds are reopened.

title: The Telepathy Tapes
overview: Expands on "The Telepathy Tapes" podcast that explores communication and consciousness among nonspeaking individuals.

title: The Young People
overview: Centers on a couple of school friends, one of whom starts to develop red flag behavior.

title: K-POP: The Debut
overview: Lizzy Lee, a young Korean-American woman, has spent her life following the path her family chose for her. But when she earns a spot in a globally televised competition to form the next K-pop girl group, she travels to Seoul, South Korea, to pursue the dream she must still keep hidden.

title: I Rarely Wake Up Dreaming
overview: The love of Olya and Oleh, a young queer Ukrainian couple, is put to the test when one partner’s gender transition collides with Russia’s full-scale invasion. As war narrows and challenges the boundaries of masculinity and femininity, they struggle to preserve their bond and sense of self. What does it mean to be a man in a country that is fighting for its identity and survival?

title: Panic Carefully
overview: Described as a paranoid thriller about a hunt for a cyber-terrorist in the vein of Mr. Robot and The Silence of the Lambs.

title: Vanya
overview: Vanya doesn't know his father. His mother says he works in Moscow. With friend Fedya, Vanya meets Viktor, his mother's former classmate who lived in Germany, wondering if he's Vanya's dad as they prepare to search for him in Moscow.

title: The Revenge of La Llorona
overview: A grieving mother's ancient curse targets a troubled family, forcing them to confront their own hidden past while fighting to survive her supernatural wrath.

title: Maslenitsa
overview: Polina and Olya have been friends since childhood. Polina lives for her studies, but her quiet life ends when the girl who dreams of going to study in China fails the selection for an exchange program. It seems that life has lost its meaning, but then an opportunity arises to fix everything: you just need to spend Maslenitsa week with a student from China, immersing him in our culture and introducing him to the traditions of seeing off winter. This student turns out to be the son of a high-ranking Chinese official, the arrogant Wang Yu with a difficult character, but nothing can stop Polina from using her last chance. Nothing, except a broken leg. Olya knows that studying in China is Polina's blue dream, so she immediately decides to help her friend by replacing her during Maslenitsa week.

title: Mädchen in Uniform
overview: In 1914, a tender, forbidden love blossoms between a new pupil and her young teacher in the middle of a military-run boarding school for girls. It soon develops into a passionate affair that shakes this fortress of patriarchy to its core.

title: Sue Horn Mangkorn How
overview: Plot TBA.

title: Guardian Rabbits: The Secret of the Golden Egg
overview: In the new film, rabbit girl Emmy is chosen as the new Guardian of the Golden Egg — the magical source of Easter — but she doubts she can live up to the legacy. Her worries grow when a group of badgers takes over the Rabbit School and steals the Egg. On her rescue mission, she uncovers a hidden truth: the badgers are trying to save their dying ancient tree, the heart of their world. Faced with an impossible choice, Emmy unites rabbits, foxes and badgers, proving that the true magic of Easter is courage, unity and sharing its light with all. Set to be released on Easter 2027

title: Rebecca Horn – The Secret Life of Things
overview: This film explores the complex body of work by Rebecca Horn, whose kinetic objects, installations, and films expanded the concept of art in the 20th century. Her work paved the way for future generations of artists. Director Claudia Müller explores Horn’s work within the context of her time and examines its significance in the present day.

title: Выжить во льдах
overview: Antarctica, early 1980s. Following an emergency at the Soviet polar station "Voshod," the crew finds themselves in an extreme situation: temperatures are plummeting to minus 70 degrees Celsius, they are surrounded by an icy wasteland stretching for thousands of kilometers, and immediate evacuation is impossible. The station chief, Serov, makes a series of unconventional decisions that threaten to trigger yet another catastrophe. Realizing this, Rodin—a member of the team—understands that to save his fellow crew members, he must defy orders and take responsibility for the team himself.

title: The Hollow Season
overview: In the remote mountain town of Graven Hollow, autumn is more than just a season — it’s a warning. Every thirteen years, as the harvest moon rises and the leaves turn blood-red, the town prepares for a ritual it dares not speak aloud. When a group of college friends arrives for the annual fall festival, they’re drawn into a chilling legend about the Hollow Man — a masked figure born of fire and betrayal, who returns to collect a blood debt. As the friends unravel the town’s secrets and fight to survive, they discover that tradition runs deep… and some roots are soaked in horror.

title: Sants
overview: While dealing with her mother’s impending death, Lali joins a gang of thieves dedicated to stealing religious artefacts. ​

title: Vampyr
overview: A struggling author, obsessed with Edvard Munch, finds himself on the verge of madness when he's dragged into a dangerous murder mystery surrounding the world-famous painter.

title: Pierre the Pigeon-Hawk
overview: In New York City, Pierre, born as a product of forbidden love between a hawk and a pigeon, is rejected by both communities. Tired of not fitting in, Pierre sets out on a mission to discover where he truly belongs.

title: The Scar-faced Cat: Way of Asura
overview: A vengeful Taiwanese maiko breaks out of prison to kill every Japanese cop who raped her, only to realize it was the person closest to her who first put her through hell.

title: Live Like That
overview: Based on an inspiring story about a family whose faith is tested by an unimaginable loss, and what they choose to do next, in the midst of grief, they make a surprising decision. Instead of responding with anger, they choose forgiveness and set out to help heal a divided community. What begins as private heartbreak becomes a broader movement of hope and connection, showing how faith, love, and unity can bring light even to the darkest moments.

title: Wafflehead
overview: Two documentarians settle into a small town and persuade a few hillbilly locals to help them find the sole survivor of a massacre.

title: Ghattada Bhoota
overview: The film follows a deeply grounded human story that gradually unfolds into a world of mystery, folklore and the unexplained.

title: 1 Litre of Tears
overview: Movie "1 litre of tears", coming in 2027

title: The Last Time You Were Real
overview: New technology forces an alcoholic to reckon with his past.

title: Mico 45/45
overview: Plot TBA. Described as portrait of a young adult from Northeastern Brazil searching for meaning in the life around him and within himself.

title: Dorian Gray, or Narcissus Through the Looking Glass
overview: Dorian Gray is but a boy, yet he's worshipped as a God - by the closeted painter who immortalized his beauty, by the libertine who taught him all of the world's secret pleasures, and by himself. For the next one hundred years, Dorian Gray falls into a rabbit-hole of debauchery, remaining forever young while his portrait pays the price for each of his sins. But when crimes of decades past come back to haunt him, and the novelty of everlasting youth starts taking its toll, can his soul still be redeemed?

title: Just Another John
overview: A mysterious entity closes in around John, keeping him trapped inside his house. The only thing protecting him from being crushed is the egg timer ticking down on his kitchen table.

title: Shoplifters
overview: Two boys attempt to shoplift in a convenience store.

title: Look at Vision
overview: When Franciszek Gołas had nothing but a vision and a dream in his head, he didn't know if anyone would understand. This is the story of an idea he refused to left.
